questions.question: A tank truck usually has:
questions.explanation: Tank trucks have a high center of gravity. This makes them harder to control. The cargo can also shift during driving, especially if it is liquid.

questions.question: Portable tanks:

options.text: Cannot be removed from a vehicle.
Are not permanently attached to a vehicle.
Are permanently attached to a vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Are not permanently attached to a vehicle.
questions.explanation: Cargo tanks stay on a vehicle at all times. Portable tanks are different. They are not permanently attached to a vehicle.

questions.question: How can a driver stay alert while driving?
questions.explanation: Eating heavy foods or keeping the cab too warm can make you drowsy. Exercise and a healthy diet help you stay alert while driving.

questions.question: One way to prevent a rollover is to:

options.text: Move cargo to the left side of the truck.
Keep cargo centered on the truck.
Move cargo to the right side of the truck.
Keep cargo as far from the ground as possible.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep cargo centered on the truck.
questions.explanation: A rollover happens more easily if cargo is loaded unevenly. Keep the load centered on the truck to help prevent rollovers.

questions.question: On shipping papers, identification numbers, shipping names, and hazard classes:

options.text: Should be abbreviated if using a small piece of paper.
Should be abbreviated to make them easier to read.
Should only be abbreviated if the abbreviations are easy to understand.

questions.explanation: Never abbreviate identification numbers, shipping names, or hazard classes on shipping papers. The only exception is if the abbreviation is specifically allowed by hazardous materials rules.

questions.question: A cargo van usually:

options.text: Is the same height whether loaded or empty.
Is taller when carrying a heavy load than a light load.
Is shorter when carrying a heavy load than a light load.

questions.correctAnswerText: Is shorter when carrying a heavy load than a light load.
questions.explanation: A heavy load pushes the vehicle down, making it sit lower. An empty vehicle sits higher. A vehicle that fits under a bridge when full may not fit when empty.

questions.question: Who must label hazardous materials?
questions.explanation: The shipper is responsible for packaging, marking, and labeling hazardous materials. The shipper must also provide placards.

questions.question: The emergency air line supplies air to the:
questions.explanation: The emergency air line (also called the supply line) does two things. It supplies air to the trailer air tanks and controls the emergency brakes on the trailer.

questions.question: When loading liquid cargo, you should consider:

options.text: The air pressure in the tires.
The speed limits on the route.

questions.explanation: When loading liquid, consider how much the liquid will expand during transit, the weight of the liquid, and legal weight limits.

questions.question: Older trailers do not have spring brakes. If the air supply leaks away:

options.text: The trailer will not have brakes.

questions.correctAnswerText: The trailer will not have brakes.
questions.explanation: Older trailers do not have spring brakes. If the air tank leaks completely, there will be no brakes on the trailer. The wheels will turn freely.

questions.question: How many identical placards must be placed on a vehicle transporting hazardous materials?
questions.explanation: Hazardous materials placards must be placed on all four sides of the vehicle.

questions.question: What happens when a vehicle has ABS on only one axle?

options.text: It gives the driver better control when braking.
It puts extra strain on the other axles.

questions.correctAnswerText: It gives the driver better control when braking.
questions.explanation: ABS on even one axle helps the driver control the vehicle better when braking.

questions.question: When should you turn off your turn signal during a turn?
questions.explanation: Keep your signal on the entire time you are turning. Turn it off only after you finish the turn.

questions.question: When driving a tank vehicle, how should you take curves?

options.text: Faster than the posted speed limit
Slower than the posted speed limit
Use both lanes if there are two lanes of traffic

questions.correctAnswerText: Slower than the posted speed limit
questions.explanation: Tank vehicles have a high center of gravity and can roll over easily. Drive well below the speed limit on curves to stay safe.

questions.question: Why are roads slippery when it first starts to rain?

options.text: Rain mixes with oil on the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Rain mixes with oil on the road.
questions.explanation: When rain first starts, it mixes with oil and grease on the road, creating a slippery film. This washes away as more rain falls.

questions.question: If there are two left turn lanes, which one should you use?

options.text: Trucks should not turn where there are two left turn lanes

questions.explanation: Large vehicles may need to swing right when making a left turn. Use the right turn lane to start your left turn.

questions.question: To check the automatic transmission fluid level in some vehicles, what must you do?
questions.explanation: In some vehicles, you must leave the engine running when checking the automatic transmission fluid level.

questions.question: When driving a vehicle with ABS, how should you brake?

options.text: Use extra force to activate ABS
Brake the same as a vehicle without ABS
Brake with less force than normal

questions.correctAnswerText: Brake the same as a vehicle without ABS
questions.explanation: Brake normally in a vehicle with ABS. Use the same braking technique you would use in a vehicle without ABS.

questions.question: What should you do about broken suspension parts?
questions.explanation: The suspension system holds up the vehicle and keeps axles in place. Broken suspension parts are very dangerous and must be fixed immediately.

questions.question: What does an Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS) do?

options.text: Makes it easier to turn a large vehicle

questions.explanation: ABS prevents the wheels from locking up during hard braking.
